notes.title: Even more great updates for GRUNND!
notes.content:
I was not sure whether GRUNND needs it. But in the end I decided YES.

With this update GRUNND gets an option to manually Save and Load games via two optional slots. There will be always an AutoSave - it will not go anywhere, but this extra flexibility, if you needed one, will make playing GRUNND more enjoyable.

Also updated Ending a bit, and some small fixes I don't even remember. Should've written those down.

Also yesterday sent out keys to our BETA testers, who participated in testing during December.

Update the installation!

- Olafs @ GRUNND

- improved "hotspots" in some occasions to make clicking on them easier [so you don't have to be over-precise with your positioning];
- infinite loop bug should be fixed [but I will continue to monitor reports on this one];

notes.title: Special GRUNND SteamNextFest update is live!
notes.content:
It's been a tough week. But it works! The new Demo Update, just for the SteamNextFest, features a brand new Pause Menu - now you can experience the thing, that is much closer to it's final state. 

- A beautiful map to reveal!
- Follow Quests;
- See the Inventory and read up on items you've got.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39265062/26ec1c37400811c86f016fc8e84828384771bea4.jpg[/img]

We do have a minor setback as well - controller does not work in Main Menu. But it will be fixed. Within game you can use controller as intended :) So sorry about that.

What else... See you LIVE on Tuesday and Thursday!

- Olafs @ GRUNND

notes.title: More Bug Fixes.
notes.content:
Reacting to the reports about game being stuck in the Infinite Loading Loop and Camera issues.

Released UPDATE 1.0.7
- updated the buttons for traveling between Hubs [Scenes] preventing any extra clicks being registered after the initial one - hoping this was causing the game being stuck in the loop;
- changed Camera Update to Fixed - this might prevent of camera being stuck outside the intended game window.

Known Issues
- AVG Antivirus is throwing false positive on game's executable. It's a known issue for a lot of games [apparently] - just define the .exe as exception withing AVG. Nothing we can do here.

Upcoming UPDATE 1.0.71
- working on correct loading in when the game has been Exited and then continued via Continue button within Main Menu.
